title_sq: Apartament 2+1 +Verande ne shitje tek Selvia, Prane Viles Gold - Tirane
description_sq:
Ne nje nga zonat me qendrore te Tiranes, Tek Selvia, Shitet Apartment 2+1, me siperfaqe totale 91 m².
Apartamenti pozicionohet ne katin e 8-te banim (kat i fundit), ne nje pallat te ri me ashensor (ndertim i vitit 2025).
Organizohet ne sallon, korridor shperndares, 2 dhome gjumi, 1 tualet (me dritare) dhe verande.
Apartamenti eshte i gjithi i shtruar me parket, ka panele diellore, kondicioner ne cdo ambient dhe shitet bosh. Tualeti eshte totalisht i investuar me punime ekstra.
Apartamenti ka nje pamje panoramike te qytetit dhe drite natyrale gjate gjithe dites.
Apartamenti disponon dokumentacion te rregullt nga firma e ndertimit.
Aktualisht apartamenti eshte i dhene me qera me kliente te huaj, cka tregon qe eshte edhe nje mundesi e favorshme investimi me kthim te garantuar.
title_en: Apartment 2+1 + Veranda for sale in Selvia, Near Vilas Gold - Tirana
description_en: In one of the most central areas of Tirana, in Selvia, Apartment 2+1 for sale, with a total area of ​​91 m². The apartment is located on the 8th residential floor (top floor), in a new building with an elevator (built in 2025). It is organized in living room, distribution corridor, 2 bedrooms, 1 bathroom (with window) and veranda. The apartment is all laid with parquet, has solar panels, air conditioning in every room and is sold empty. The toilet is totally invested with extra works. The apartment has a panoramic view of the city and natural light throughout the day. The apartment has regular documentation from the construction company. Currently, the apartment is rented out to foreign clients, which shows that it is also a favorable investment opportunity with a guaranteed return.
